title: Decision tree depth under coordinate equivalence
statement: Let $m,n$ be nonnegative integers, let $e:\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\cong\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be a bijection, and let $f:\mathbb F_2^m\to\alpha$. Define a function on $\mathbb F_2^n$ by reading the coordinates indexed by $e$ and applying $f$. Its decision tree depth equals the decision tree depth of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: bijection e between the m and n coordinate sets
function f from ℱ₂^m to α
